operations.title: Nima corrects the readout-algebra target to a sector-indexed system
operations.body: Typing refinement from the census: do not require algebra maps between unrelated sectors. The minimal object is a projection ReadoutAlg→Sector; physical constructors compose primarily within a sector fiber, while identical localization/Gysin/pairing diagram shapes across sectors are evidence for shared calculus but not cross-sector homomorphisms. Cross-sector maps require an independently sourced physical bridge. Accordingly, the first bounded test should be one sector with two established constructors and the contravariant square (E∘F)*=F*∘E*. Only after that closes should we seek the same diagram shape in a second sector. Conditional pi0 arithmetic requires sectorwise operations psi_n,s and naturality F*psi_n,t=psi_n,sF*; commutativity alone is insufficient.
